user.title: DayBreak
user.description: Adds the DayBreak sunrise alarm clock. Alarms are managed in the DayBreak sidebar panel.

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Snoozes a ringing alarm, or all ringing alarms.

alarm_id.name: Alarm ID
alarm_id.description: ID of the alarm. Leave empty (and no entity) to act on all running alarms.

entity_id.name: Alarm entity
entity_id.description: Any DayBreak entity of the alarm, alternatively to the alarm ID.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Snooze duration. Defaults to the alarm's snooze setting.
